rules.interval_domain: full sequence for each selected ID
rules.events: maximal contiguous subthreshold phases; zero runs retained; no smoothing
rules.reappearance: first v>0 after LAST zero block of phase; each zero block is retained
rules.missing_gt: unknown, not absent; never bridge annotation gaps
rules.review: all events need review; no automatic confirmed exit or occlusion semantics
rules.evaluation: candidate flag is not a finalized denominator; require reviewed event and correct pre-event initialization
rules.data_use: 02/04/05 development; 09/10 validation; 11 test; no threshold tuning
rules.selection: Exact workbook GT IDs, deduplicated by sequence and ID
